state: R^3 x R^3 x SO(3) x R^3
grid_assumption: A bounded normalized coordinate window, with m = 2^ell intervals on every axis. This is not a specified physical grid or a global chart of SO(3).
memory_assumption: A materialized image-hull table with 24 binary64 coordinates per cell; excludes the grid, graph edges, and homology. This is storage for the specified table, not a universal algorithmic lower bound.

calibration.description: Saved uniform original-space O(3) timing, measured on Apple M4 Pro with 14 cores and 48 GiB RAM, one numerical thread.

time_assumption: Linear projection of the saved O(3) map-plus-Morse time per cell. The O(3) closed-form hull is cheaper than full-plant integration. This is an optimistic illustration, not a measured time or a proved lower bound.
conley_index_time: Not estimated; no linear scaling assumption is made.
comparison_scope: The learned interval describes the sphere subsystem on eta=0. The SO(2) quotient of the full plant has dimension 11. No full-plant-to-interval timing speedup is claimed.
domain_scope: The plant state space is noncompact and position is unregulated. Coordinate ranges, attitude charts, and window exits must be specified before an actual full-state computation.
